source_pattern_name_zh: 群体遗传学——Hardy-Weinberg平衡、等位基因频率、表型均值计算
activation_signals: Problem gives genotype or allele frequencies and asks for a population-level quantitative average (height, weight, fitness).
Problem involves Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium derivation of allele/genotype frequencies.
Problem requires multiple simultaneous conditions (parent genotype AND offspring genotype) to determine phenotype.
Key vocabulary: Hardy-Weinberg, allele frequency, genotype frequency, homozygous, heterozygous, population bottleneck, random mating, dominant, recessive, phenotype average.
problem_signatures: 题目给出某等位基因纯合子频率（如50%），并结合其他表型规则，要求计算群体平均身高/体重/性状值。
题目要求从基因型频率推导等位基因频率（q = sqrt(P(aa))）。
题目中表型依赖于多个独立条件（父亲基因型AND孩子基因型），需要联合概率计算。
题目包含'population bottleneck'、'Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium'和定量性状计算。
likely_failure_modes: Only using parent's genotype to determine P(phenotype), ignoring that the child's own genotype also determines whether they can express the phenotype (e.g., digest/consume the resource).
Confusing allele frequency q with genotype frequency q²: if P(aa)=0.5, then q=sqrt(0.5)≈0.707, not q=0.5.
Treating parent and offspring genotypes as correlated under HWE when they are actually independent (random mating).
Applying survivorship selection models when the problem states HWE is maintained (selection would violate HWE).

sop_phases.title: Phase 1 — Parse Frequencies and Conditions
steps: Identify allele labels and dominance relationships.
Derive allele frequencies from stated genotype frequencies using HWE: q=sqrt(P(aa)), p=1-q.
List all genotypes and verify frequencies sum to 1.
Enumerate ALL conditions required for each phenotypic outcome, noting which depend on own genotype vs parent genotype.

sop_phases.title: Phase 2 — Compute Joint Probabilities
steps: For multi-condition phenotypes, multiply independent probabilities: P(outcome) = P(cond1) × P(cond2).
Compute probability and trait value for each phenotypic class.
Verify all class probabilities sum to 1.

sop_phases.title: Phase 3 — Compute Population Average and Round
steps: Self-audit: confirm every stated condition was incorporated into the joint probability.

subtype_playbook: **HWE derivation**: P(aa)=f → q=sqrt(f), p=1-sqrt(f), P(Aa)=2pq, P(AA)=p².
**Single-parent-determined trait**: P(benefit) = P(parent functional). avg = P×high + (1-P)×low.
**Two-condition trait**: P(benefit) = P(parent functional) × P(child functional) = (1-q²)². avg = P×high + (1-P)×low.
**Quantitative trait, three genotype classes**: avg = P(AA)×v_AA + P(Aa)×v_Aa + P(aa)×v_aa.
**Bottleneck + HWE**: consistent iff q=sqrt(P(aa)) holds after random mating resumes.
output_rules: Show intermediate table: allele freqs → genotype freqs → per-class probabilities → weighted sum.
State explicitly which conditions were multiplied and why.
Round to the precision specified in the problem.
